related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents. Use provenance-linked observations from authentic development to relate agent objectives, capability implementation, discoverability and use, environmental conditions, language and compiler pressures, verification, and outcomes. Make remaining host implementations and native opportunities inspectable only where authoritative evidence supports them. Treat usage and resource measures as diagnostic evidence, not agent scores or adoption targets. Preserve uncertainty, respect active compiler ownership, and verify environmental changes independently through existing mechanisms.

outcome.implementation_change: The observation contract now supports pressure_hypothesis_role values occurrence and supporting-context. Recurrence counts only occurrence records; linked implementation records remain excluded and supporting-context records do not contribute an additional occurrence. The existing append-only correction contract can apply an exact, integrity-verified pressure_hypothesis_role correction, preserving the original source record while fixing its projected evidence role.
not_measured: whether the corrected projection changes later agent investigation decisions
whether similar over-counted recurrence appears in other campaign histories
whether the role distinction remains useful across other pressure evidence types

pressure_hypothesis.title: Linked verification context can inflate pressure recurrence counts
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A selected campaign page contained one pressure observation and a linked verification record that repeated the same pressure hypothesis. The projection counted both as occurrences and reported repeated-within-session, though only the first record described a pressure occurrence.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Represent whether a record is an occurrence or supporting context for a pressure hypothesis, and allow a verified append-only correction to repair earlier role attribution without rewriting the source record.
not_measured: how often improvement and verification records repeat pressure hypotheses across existing campaigns
whether any other recurrence conclusions are affected
whether an agent relied on the repeated-within-session interpretation
whether subsequent projection use confirms the new role field is discoverable

improvement_relation.basis: Role-aware recurrence treats verification records as supporting context when explicitly marked and preserves the original record through the existing correction mechanism. Targeted tests cover exact target verification, correction application, compact-role preservation, and non-recurrence. Immediate live verification is recorded separately; no subsequent agent behavior is claimed.
not_measured: whether future observations identify supporting context without a correction
whether future independent pressure incidents recur across sessions
whether the new role distinction remains appropriate for all operational evidence types

measurement_limits: Historical records are not rewritten; exact-pointer append-only corrections supply the effective role.
Records without an explicit role retain the prior occurrence default for compatibility.
The code and tests establish the correction mechanism, not its long-term use or effectiveness.

supporting_sources.verified_behavior: Applies role corrections to verified target records and excludes supporting-context hypotheses from occurrence recurrence.
Tests an apparent repeated-within-session result before correction and one not-established occurrence after the exact correction is applied.
Documents occurrence versus supporting-context roles and append-only role corrections.
